apps.name: Bug-Bounty
apps.subtitle: Native companion for Bug-Bounty Mission Control
apps.localizedDescription: Connects to an explicitly started Bug-Bounty PC bridge on your trusted local network. View live work, reports, guidelines, campaigns and model status; create local drafts; and pair by scanning the PC QR code. The phone cannot execute targets, run models, expose provider credentials, approve outbound content or submit reports.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds secure QR pairing, a native Mission Control app icon, and the complete paired companion experience.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the one-time pairing QR code shown by your Bug-Bounty PC.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connect securely to your explicitly started Bug-Bounty companion bridge on this PC.
